g.title: j3193862264
g.text: Mon miracle, I... must make very certain you understand something before I tell you this next anecdote of mine.

g.title: j1392651392->j3193862264
g.text: LyonDating

g.title: j3287480167
g.text: I am not surprised that Marie caught your heart in her hands like a butterfly. She is... quite something.

g.title: j1392651392->j3287480167
g.text: MarieDating

g.title: j1392651392->j1243665097
g.text: RoatheDating

g.title: j3835148194
g.text: How're you doing today, Lyon?

g.title: j1392651392->j3835148194
g.text: false

g.title: j2614499038
g.text: [Confess feelings.] Lyon? I was wondering if we could talk about something.

g.title: j1392651392->j2614499038
g.text: false

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j1392651392->j242691715
g.text: false

g.title: j2428223341
g.text: It is important to me that you are paying very close attention to these next words that I send you. Do you understand?

g.title: j2183298434
g.text: Check boolean LyonHasDated

g.title: j4081834027
g.text: I am glad there is someone who can find the strength to reach through the nettles of Roathe's personality to see the broken thing that lies within.

g.title: j1766143879
g.text: Might I ask what I fear is to be an indelicate question, my friend?

g.title: j1243665097->j1766143879
g.text: false

g.title: j2718895134
g.text: What a wonderfully benign and charmingly mundane question. I do not get asked this often.

g.title: j2661440882
g.text: Yes, what is it? Is something the matter?

g.title: j4070374332
g.text: You're making me nervous. What's wrong?

g.title: j3410229811
g.text: Yes, I'm here. Go ahead.

g.title: j3332170140
g.text: I didn't know how you'd feel, since...

g.title: j2183298434->j3332170140
g.text: true

g.title: j728210504
g.text: I'm kind of... in awe of her.

g.title: j2183298434->j728210504
g.text: true

g.title: j2183298434->j728210504
g.text: false

g.title: j2954261560
g.text: Is this a conversation where you threaten me? Or?

g.title: j2183298434->j2954261560
g.text: true

g.title: j2183298434->j2954261560
g.text: false

g.title: j58302161
g.text: I know, though he denies it vehemently, that he believes himself a coward. I would not label him as such.

g.title: j843739938
g.text: Of course. I've asked you plenty.

g.title: j2693128618
g.text: Why am I dating Roathe?

g.title: j2527111940
g.text: I am... quite well, thank you.

g.title: j2396878354
g.text: Never mind. Sorry. Forgot what I was going to say, actually.

g.title: j3773332689
g.text: I don't know how to phrase it best, so I'm going to come right out and say it - I have feelings for you.

g.title: j548002484
g.text: Nothing is wrong - quite the opposite. That is what is so imperative for you to comprehend - the dire consequences from which I wish to free you, should you assume they might follow.

g.title: j613804273
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3400275805
g.text: Ha. Do you think I am surprised? I stand in the shadow of her light and always have. No, my friend - I am not bitter or jealous over this, I promise you.

g.title: j1804963912
g.text: As are we all. The sister of my soul never ceases to amaze me. I am happy for you both beyond the ability for words to express.

g.title: j218221709
g.text: Hm? No. I would hardly be so bullish as to stomp about and pretend to be her guardian. She is quite capable of breaking your bones if she decides you are so worthy.

g.title: j3323593791
g.text: Entrati told him he would be needed to save a future he did not know. One that he had no kingship over, no people to grovel at his feet, no servants to worship him.

g.title: j3874385234
g.text: What... do you see in Roathe that has led you two into... courtship?

g.title: j930926675
g.text: I see you have either already faced this line of questioning, or you were expecting it. Yes. Precisely that. What... do you see in him?

g.title: j3192870469
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j757720619
g.text: Happens to me frequently. Often when I pass through doorways. Oft I have wondered why that is.

g.title: j2434090358
g.text: I... you are... certain? Are you well? You have not hit your head recently, have you?

g.title: j3937136035
g.text: I'm listening.

g.title: j1485963904
g.text: You're not making much sense.

g.title: j96225943
g.text: Dire consequences of... what?

g.title: j2309858857
g.text: Thank you. Before I begin I wish to assure you that there is nothing wrong - however, therein lies perhaps the dire consequences from which I wish to free you, should you assume they might follow.

g.title: j2639327783
g.text: I hold no resentment over what passed between us, I am still only able to express my grateful soul for the time we did spend together.

g.title: j2384286918
g.text: There is such joy in her eyes when she speaks of you. She is giddy with excitement whenever she thinks you might be stopping by.

g.title: j3337065136
g.text: I merely wished to tell you that her happiness is contagious - and I find myself smiling in the thought of it as well. So for that, I also must thank you.

g.title: j1772488340
g.text: He might think it an act of fear - a rat fleeing a sinking ship - to take the serum and forget the actions that led to it.

g.title: j3340807847
g.text: To put it bluntly? Have you seen him?

g.title: j3072086499
g.text: I think there's a pain in him, somewhere beneath all the... humor and personality.

g.title: j900544057
g.text: I... can't help it. There's a darkness and a danger in him that I find alluring. It draws me in.

g.title: j2969896602
g.text: Yes, I think I am now quite well today, indeed.

g.title: j398709377
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j442702286
g.text: Why is it so hard to believe?

g.title: j1681022814
g.text: I'm sure, Lyon. I'm not concussed.

g.title: j3496963987
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2465992472
g.text: Yes. I am painfully aware of this.

g.title: j3871584006
g.text: Allow me to begin again.

g.title: j1122363636
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1671199038
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j3311435967
g.text: - Lyon

g.title: j506714654
g.text: I see it as a man who saw the calculations of the battlefield and knew when to abandon a vessel already lost. For the war was not yet over.

g.title: j3969598168
g.text: Far be it from me to condemn you.

g.title: j1815343177
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j973756130
g.text: I can understand the pull. I will not deny that I do not see it myself. However, I do hope for your sake you do not allow it to consume you.

g.title: j673605977
g.text: Have a lovely rest of your day. - Lyon

g.title: j2799241080
g.text: Well, to be blunt - when you have such other options before you... Marie or Roathe or... anyone else in the universe for that matter...

g.title: j2783825046
g.text: I am aware that I can be construed by many, and in fact, very well might be, in reality, to be... unwell. At the very least, I am not entirely of sound mind.

g.title: j447801819
g.text: Now, I am happy you spend it with her. She will bring you joy, where I could only bring you sadness. Be happy with her. You have all of my blessings.

g.title: j1494212890
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j2397892380
g.text: Though, for your sake, I do hope this fancy passes quickly and does not become an addiction. I have seen such things destroy others.

g.title: j4069352853
g.text: Yes, I have seen it myself. Buried deep, though it may be. But he may not welcome your attempts to pry. I believe he enjoys what he has become.

g.title: j2751911678
g.text: Such arrangements should be based on more than... simple darkness. I shall not lecture you, however.

g.title: j489569787
g.text: I have trouble believing you would choose to dally with a broken stained glass window such as I... lest you were gravely ill.

g.title: j2189956678
g.text: I have long since come to be at peace with this. It does not trouble me any longer. The visions that plague me - the voices - I have come to find ways to live with them without fear or hatred.

g.title: j2734464914
g.text: I'm just happy to be there for him, in any way that I can.

g.title: j1494212890->j2734464914
g.text: RoatheVillian

g.title: j1494212890->j2734464914
g.text: RoatheRedeemed

g.title: j1494212890->j2734464914
g.text: false

g.title: j3293892259
g.text: What happened to him is... complicated. I think he'll be sorting through it for a long while.

g.title: j1494212890->j3293892259
g.text: RoatheVillian

g.title: j1494212890->j3293892259
g.text: RoatheRedeemed

g.title: j1494212890->j3293892259
g.text: false

g.title: j2752881010
g.text: Exactly. He did it to win the war - and sometimes that means losing a few battles.

g.title: j1494212890->j2752881010
g.text: RoatheVillian

g.title: j1494212890->j2752881010
g.text: RoatheRedeemed

g.title: j2980557629
g.text: He'll forgive himself in time. But I don't think the outer shell will ever really change.

g.title: j1494212890->j2980557629
g.text: RoatheRedeemed

g.title: j112046440
g.text: You know your own mind and your limits. I wish you both well.

g.title: j1455573671
g.text: Lyon? I have feelings for you. I care about you. I'd like to be with you, if you'd like to be with me.

g.title: j65825026
g.text: If you're saying it's not mutual...

g.title: j3158466825
g.text: (Lately, I think, a little out of spite if I might be honest, but that is neither here nor there.)

g.title: j1809747025
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2822246282
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1857231203
g.text: Forgive me, please forgive me - I simply - I thought it was impossible, this is... not something I... could have... imagined...

g.title: j2845891557
g.text: Hardly! That is not what I mean to imply! Far - far from it, in fact, I simply - I thought it was impossible, this is... not something I... could have... imagined...

g.title: j3693792089
g.text: But I wish you to understand that if you were to end this between us - this bond that I thought was previously heretofore impossible between myself and another -

g.title: j2039376135
g.text: To which I wish you both the absolute best of luck.

g.title: j1519708948
g.text: Besides, now that he seems to have an "itch to scratch," he has stopped goading Marie in to open conflict.

g.title: j4291643733
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j181320283
g.text: If you were to ever let your heart wander away from mine?

g.title: j3425393143
g.text: Well. Not as frequently, at any rate. Farewell for now.

g.title: j3776701407
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j4291643733->j3776701407
g.text: RoatheDating

g.title: j2412431937
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j4291643733->j2412431937
g.text: MarieDating

g.title: j184601558

g.title: j552213775
g.text: I will endure, mon miracle.

g.title: j3022846817
g.text: While I am... deeply touched, and I... do not know the customs of this time, I fear I must refuse.

g.title: j3640149632
g.text: While I am... deeply touched, and I... do not know the customs of this time, I fear I must refuse.

g.title: j1271585627
g.text: You truly are mon miracle...

g.title: j3242067955
g.text: I will not be consumed by that which has plagued me.

g.title: j3728321999
g.text: As you are otherwise currently... engaged with Roathe. I do not wish to even comprehend the kind of complications such an entanglement would cause.

g.title: j571226346
g.text: As you are otherwise currently engaged with Marie. She is too dear to me to think that my relationship with you might detract from hers. Or distract from it in any way.

g.title: j1374158912
g.text: Boolean LyonDating is now true.

g.title: j1697539566
g.text: Check boolean LyonAllRight

g.title: j708781519
g.text: My mind is complicated enough, I fear, to think of you and he, a man I know so well, together. Perhaps I am old-fashioned in that regard. I am a walking relic, it seems. For that, you must forgive me.

g.title: j53504905
g.text: Perhaps I am old fashioned in that regard. She is like my family, and we are too close. I am a walking relic, it seems. For that, you must forgive me.

g.title: j4115967391
g.text: Boolean IsDating is now true.

g.title: j744145472
g.text: I will be, to use your colloquialism, "all right." I will find cause to smile and laugh once more.

g.title: j1697539566->j744145472
g.text: true

g.title: j2073349236
g.text: I will survive. I will be fine. I will find cause to smile and laugh once more.

g.title: j1697539566->j2073349236
g.text: false

g.title: j3642226382
g.text: Boolean LyonHasDated is now true.

g.title: j1877637589
g.text: Oh, Lyon... you aren't a burden to me.

g.title: j363282189
g.text: Are you... saying you want to end things between us?

g.title: j2219990608
g.text: I am simply attempting to free you of any perceived hardship you might feel on my account...

g.title: j4181332823
g.text: No! Anything of the sort! I am simply attempting to free you of any perceived hardship you might feel on my account.

g.title: j3011004471
g.text: Your pain... echoes a kind of my own. It'd never be a hardship to help you through it.

g.title: j2588881899
g.text: I can't describe what draws me to you. But you will never be a duty or a burden.

g.title: j2566163748
g.text: [Break up.] This is all just become too much for me, I'm sorry. It might be best to end things here.

g.title: j2989175492
g.text: To which I cannot express how much my heart breaks in turn for you. But that I am forever grateful that our lonely ghosts of pain have found each other.

g.title: j1433573642
g.text: To which I cannot properly express my gratitude, and I do not think any words ever can.

g.title: j542334940
g.text: Yes. Of course. It would be... hypocritical to accept any other answer at this point in time...

g.title: j275442452
g.text: But now that I have gone through great pains to go through what has been a most spectacularly self-indulgent preamble...

g.title: j121445896
g.text: I understand completely. And I wish you nothing but the best. And I will cherish all the moments we have spent together.

g.title: j3341162535
g.text: For a guy who started off silent, you really did get wordy.

g.title: j1253470459
g.text: I find them endearing, don't worry.

g.title: j2094291099
g.text: You could've just said "I'll be fine, you know, if we ever go our separate ways."

g.title: j4130561079
g.text: I will remember them in my soul, even if they vanish from my mind. Farewell.

g.title: j419560915
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j4187943851
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3287031406
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3994460333
g.text: Boolean LyonDating is now false.

g.title: j725038002
g.text: Bah! If you did not wish to be privy to the inner workings of my mind, you should not have gone poking about. You are entirely to blame for that.

g.title: j4074233472
g.text: I am quite glad you enjoy my wanderings. This is precisely why I choose to speak as little as I do. Can you imagine enduring this in person? Marie would have put me down years ago like a mad dog.

g.title: j3095565797
g.text: There is a certain amount of irreverence and sarcasm to which you naturally prevail that I could never hope to ascend. I will leave it to you.

g.title: j4254443866
g.text: Boolean IsDating is now false.

g.title: j1460635187
g.text: Nevertheless, all of this was meant to serve as pretext to a story that will now seem quite short in comparison to the rest...

g.title: j1640415856
g.text: I awoke last night from a nightmare. When I did, shadows surrounded me. This is nothing foreign or new in my state of mind. They loomed over my bed, and would not clear.

g.title: j4192472693
g.text: I was not frightened of them, for I knew they could not harm me. However, they would not be gone from my mind, either. There was only one I knew to be rid of them.

g.title: j2994652187
g.text: Pushing up from bed, I dressed as best I could, staggering through the blurry vision of the continued nightmare. I grasped my thurible and fell to my knees in the middle of my floor, and prepared to... well.

g.title: j3146855787
g.text: I prepared to "clear my mind." We shall leave it at that.

g.title: j869065970
g.text: But as I shut my eyes, my mind wandered. My thoughts drifted... to you, mon miracle...

g.title: j2837394384
g.text: The sound of your voice. The touch of your hand upon my shoulder...

g.title: j3832090186
g.text: And the visions... fled. They abandoned their post, chased away by the stronger ghost... of you.

g.title: j1688663544
g.text: I... stood. Placed my thurible upon the nightstand, and... opted to walk through the sand of the Sanctum instead...

g.title: j98295308
g.text: I can understand why you felt the need for the preamble, now.

g.title: j1686268280
g.text: I don't know what to say...

g.title: j3011036187
g.text: Yes. Well. On my walk I... instantly realized the dark danger of such a moment. That you might... come to think it a responsibility - come to see me as chains that weigh you down.

g.title: j3260391860
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1044170202
g.text: I beg of you - I pray, to any god or gods on high or below - that you never do. This is a gift you have given me, and each time in its newness I will cherish it.

g.title: j4256082621
g.text: There are no words needed, mon miracle...

g.title: j2673168414
g.text: Vow to me, mon miracle - that should the time come, that I have become for you an empty cage... you will be free of me.

g.title: j4012356546
g.text: On my walk I... instantly realized the dark danger of such a moment. That you might... come to think it a responsibility - come to see me as chains that weigh you down.

g.title: j1261128022
g.text: I shall be no hollow prison for those I love. Not for you. Not for Marie.

g.title: j327106718
g.text: [Break up.] I - I can't. I can't promise that, I'm sorry.

g.title: j1485985905
g.text: I vow it.

g.title: j3589086943
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j3712759926
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j3173581719
g.text: Thank you. Thank you, mon miracle, for your honesty. This took bravery, in this moment, and I commend you for it.

g.title: j3284805011
g.text: Thank you. Thank you, mon miracle...

g.title: j3057786873
g.text: I will cherish all the moments we have spent together. This, I mean more than you can imagine.

g.title: j3595003282
g.text: I am suddenly so very tired, as if... a great weight has been lifted from my shoulders. I fear I must go lie down.

g.title: j21916968
g.text: - Lyon

g.title: j3446510588
g.text: Boolean LyonDatingConfession is now true.
